children: -- SRX Global Inc. (NYSE American: SRXH) (the “Company” or “SRX”), an AI-enabled platform dedicated to generating long-term shareholder value through investments in high-conviction operating companies and strategic assets, today announced that SRX Global’s CEO, Kent Cunningham, and President, EMJX Platform and Head of Asset Management, Eric Jackson, will present at the Webull Corporate Connect Series Fintech Investment Webinar, a live investor webinar hosted on the Webull platform, on September 30, 2026.
Webull Corporate Connect Series Fintech Investment Webinar
Kent Cunningham, CEO, SRX Global Inc., Eric Jackson, President, EMJX Platform and Head of Asset Management
Interested parties may register for the webinar at
. Registration is also available directly within the Webull mobile app. A Webull account is required to register and to access the live session; account setup is free and available to the public.
A replay of the webinar will be available on the Webull platform.

SRX Global is an AI-driven platform focused on generating long-term shareholder value through investments in high-conviction operating companies, strategic assets, and technology-enabled opportunities. The Company leverages proprietary technology, data analytics, and disciplined capital allocation to identify and manage investments across multiple sectors.
